unit.why: An anthology of quoted teachings on redemption and the messiah (Maharal, Kozienice Maggid, R. Gedaliah of Linitz, Divrei Emet, Beit Aharon, Tanna de-Bei Eliyahu) plus a halakhic note on stains. The king's-feast passage is a mashal inside a homily, and 'once they spoke before him about the messiah and he said' only introduces a saying, so neither is a narrative.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the heading 'מענין הדלקת נרות'; the Sefer Hasidim story about the village shamash begins in the next division
